newsitem.title: FRANCE: Blasts destroy Corsica town hall, hit holiday camp.
newsitem.headline: Blasts destroy Corsica town hall, hit holiday camp.

text.p: Two blasts destroyed a town hall and damaged part of a holiday camp during the night in Corsica, which has long been racked by separatist violence, police said on Tuesday.
The first explosion in Porto-Vecchio heavily damaged a restaurant in a holiday camp for a postal workers' association. No one was injured, police said.

A second blast around midnight reduced to rubble the town hall of Zonza south of the island capital Ajaccio. A nearby post office and several houses were also damaged by the explosion, which caused no injuries.
No one claimed responsibility for either attack, but the Zonza town hall has been hit by blasts several times in the past few years.
Corsican separatist movements have conducted a 20-year guerrilla campaign against central rule by authorities in Paris.
